{{Quote|We try an experiment. ''Whirlwind'': move to deployment position. Fighter Four: probe attack, course one-one-five by three-eight-one.|Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
'''Fighter Four''' was a numerical designation used for one of the [[Chiss fighter]]s in [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]] under the command of [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]]. Fighter Four performed an important probing feint in the battle against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] force.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
